video_description:
Turn your messy Git commit tree into a gorgeous Tokyo / London Underground transit map with a single command: `python run.py`.

Built with an octolinear 45°/90° DAG layout engine, FastAPI, and React canvas pan/zoom.

⭐ 100% Free & Open Source under the MIT License!
🔗 Star & clone the repository: https://github.com/saarthakojha/git-subway-map

TIMESTAMPS:
0:00 The problem with standard git log
0:03 Single command execution (`python run.py`)
0:07 Tokyo Metro topological layout reveal
0:14 Merge commit interchange transfer concourses
0:21 Interactive Station Dossier Drawer (one-click SHA copy)
0:27 Realtime radar minimap & route isolation
0:31 Star the repo & loop
